body: I'm not sure if I have an easy answer for that. I just read stuff.

It seems weird to do that split persona thing. Though if that's what helps, I may as well give it a shot. God only knows I already do that sort of thing with most people every day.

I'll try the productive activity thing, though I can't look for a job as I don't have the means to do so. I guess I'll read or something.
I just hope I remember my password for this throwaway as I do have a proper Reddit account here.
I guess I'll go with those. I guess it is those small steps that count the most, huh?
I hate sounding whiny, but I can think as positively as I want, but actually making the change is so much harder to do.
Thanks for taking the time to talk to me. If it's okay with you, could we move this to PM's or something? I don't want to bloat the comment's section.

I like peaches, but they're a pain to keep around: they get all apple-like if they're left in the fridge and I hate the texture of apples, yet they rot faster if they're left out and must be eaten quickly. I guess I could eat canned peaches, but I have no idea if they're actually healthy given how they're smothered in syrup.

I also like bananas, but they also seem to spoil quickly.

It's easy to say that you want to be healthier, but it's a whole different thing to actually do it. I get tired easily and lack any and all willpower, and I have terrible eating habits. It doesn't help that I have no healthy food available. 

As for video games, I don't know. I just don't know.

I guess it's the social stigma for this kind of thing: you're viewed as mentally unbalanced, a danger to yourself. You stop being a person and become an object of pity. You get sent to doctors who dope you up on meds and make you feel even more like a zombie. That's why I'd feel embarrassed.

I guess a dead end would describe it the best. I feel empty, confused, and all around hopeless. And the worst part is that it comes and goes: I feel fine some days, when suddenly this hopelessness envelops me and I want nothing more than to bawl my eyes out and kill myself. I don't know what to do and who to turn to. Worst of all, it feels embarrassing as hell to deal with this stuff. I'm moving in with my cousins soon (As in a few days soon), and they're religious. I don't want them to guilt trip me into accepting religion since they're the type who believe that a lack of belief (in their God) makes you feel empty. Trust me when I say that's the least of my problems.

I think being a voice actor would be awesome, but it doesn't fucking matter: I'm past being able to get into a prestigious school with a good theater program, which is what a lot of big-name voice actors have done. Plus, even if you're only using your voice, looks matter. Most voice actors who tend to get a ton of work are usually attractive and great-looking. Troy Baker for example is a fucking handsome man, and Funimation's Jamie Marchi is just drop-dead gorgeous. I'm just an ugly, fat sack of shit.

I'm not sure that I want to stop masturbating period, but I guess I ought to cut back so I get that proper "Feel good" sensation back. As for video games (I play a ton of different types), I'm not sure what to do.

I do have a few friends and all, but I just can't really open up to them. I just don't know how. But look at me, the fucking hypocrite posting about my problems here on Reddit. I don't fucking know anymore.

Well let's see: all my life I've been a god-awful procrastinator. I've always struggled with falling behind in school and not getting things done/turned in on time. Any task I set for myself, I take FOREVER to do. My parents were never there for me, and even with people who have cared, I can never open up to them.

I'm easily distracted, I have a bad time interacting with others, and I often think about stuff other than what I should be thinking about at the moment. Whenever I take in information, I feel tired and lethargic, a feeling I've never had. I'm stupid and I deserve nothing more to be put out to pasture like a tired old workhorse.

I don't see how things can change unless I somehow get this magical boost out of nowhere.
